name: InterPet4D
description: Human-pet interaction estimation and generation remain underexplored due to the absence of a high-quality large-scale dataset. We present InterPet4D, the first multimodal dataset capturing natural interactions between humans and dogs. Using a synchronized multi-view capture system, we record human-dog obedience tasks and provide annotations for both humans and dogs, including multi-view and egocentric videos, segmentations, 2D and 3D keypoints, meshes, and audio tracks. InterPet4D consists of 6.8 million frames collected from 13 dogs of 11 breeds interacting with 23 human participants.
